diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~68% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 12): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (8 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.021), which favours a robust combination.

attempts.rationale: I want to test a weighted combination that uses inverse error, expecting that the top models (ARIMA, ETS, etc.) will dominate while still allowing weaker models to contribute.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; try a trimmed mean to reduce influence of outlier models.
Try a per-horizon weighted scheme using top‑k per horizon to capture changing best models across horizons.
trend strength moderate and ranking unstable, so a robust simple aggregator like median may help.
Test a robust DBA aggregator because ranking is unstable and seasonality moderate.

I want to see if a simple mean over the full pool can beat the current weighted softmax. The series has moderate seasonality and unstable rankings, so a robust but unbiased aggregator like mean may help.
Test a weighted combination using a simple inverse-error weight (w1) to see if a more direct error‑based weighting improves over softmax and inverse_error handles already used.
Test a weighted combination on the reduced, low‑error pool4 using inverse_error weights to see if a simpler subset with strong inverse weighting beats mean over full pool.
Test a per‑pool weighted softmax on the 7‑model pool to see if restricting to strong, low‑corr models improves over mean.
ranking is unstable and many models are correlated; a forward‑selection based weight (Caruana) may pick complementary models.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 1.0. Series context: trend strength 0.6848 and seasonal strength 0.6404; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.021); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.269.
